settings.engine: claude (Claude Code 2.1.302), base URL set to <proxy>/b/openmausbot
settings.bot: a new bot named Bench with the documented defaults, model claude-sonnet-5-5
settings.approval: full (the documented default for a new bot)
settings.browser: agent-browser engine as installed by the image

notes: The bot keeps one memory (files: index, topics, a daily journal of chats) across its conversations; the adapter restores those files after each attempt, as Melete's clean-up deletes a chat with what it taught memory.
Messages carry no time zone: run the server in the bench's time zone (BENCH_TIME_ZONE).
